description: Updates an existing monitor. Only the fields you pass change; the rest keep their stored values. Passing a different type converts the monitor in place, keeping its ID and history, and needs the new type's required fields, passed here or already stored. Type-specific fields go in typeFields: call getMonitorTypeFields for them. A credential sent back as "***" keeps its stored value. Read the current configuration with getMonitor; to only stop or restart checks use setMonitorActive.

databaseConnectionString.description: Connection string for the database monitor types. Sending "***" back keeps the stored value.

databasePassword.description: Password for mysql monitors. Sending "***" back keeps the stored value.

description.description: Free-text description shown on the monitor page

dns_resolve_server.description: DNS server to use for resolution (for dns type)

dns_resolve_type.description: DNS record type to query (dns and globalping)

docker_container.description: Docker container name (required for docker type)

docker_host.description: Docker host ID (required for docker type). Use listDockerHosts to find available IDs.

domainExpiryNotification.description: Notify before the domain registration expires. Needs Uptime Kuma 2.1 or later.

expectedValue.description: Threshold the json-query result is compared against, stored as a string.

expiryNotification.description: Notify before the TLS certificate expires (http, keyword, json-query, globalping)

jsonPath.description: JSONata expression for json-query monitors. Must resolve to a primitive.

maxretries.description: Max retries before marking as down

monitorID.description: The ID of the monitor to update

parent.description: Parent group monitor ID — re-parents this monitor into that group. Pass null to move it to the top level.

pushToken.description: Push token — the secret in the ping URL. Changing it invalidates the existing URL and any sender still using it stops beating.

radiusPassword.description: The RADIUS password (radius). Sending "***" back keeps the stored value.

resendInterval.description: Resend notification every N checks while down (0 = disabled)

timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds. Avoid 0: Uptime Kuma turns a stored 0 into a timeout of about 13 hours, so the monitor never reports DOWN.

type.description: New monitor type: converts the monitor in place. Pass the new type's required fields in the same call. A group cannot be converted.

typeFields.description: Fields specific to the monitor type, e.g. {"mqttTopic": "sensors/#"} for mqtt or {"bearer_token": "…"} for an HTTP monitor behind authentication. Call getMonitorTypeFields with the type for the names, meanings and allowed values — they are validated, and an unknown name is refused. getMonitor returns these fields at the top level of the monitor; to change one, pass it here.

name: updateMonitor

authMethod.description: Only when authMethod was inferred from the credentials passed. The method that was stored.

pushToken.description: Only when the type was changed to push. The token, generated if the monitor had none.

pushURL.description: Only when the type was changed to push. The URL the sender should GET.

title: Update Monitor
